module.name: prefer-string-raw
module.description: Prefer String.raw for string literals containing escaped backslashes (Sonar S7780).

scenarios.name: should allow a string literal with no backslash escapes
scenarios.when: the rule evaluates the string literal

scenarios.name: should allow a String.raw tagged template literal
scenarios.when: the rule evaluates the tagged template

scenarios.name: should report a string literal containing an escaped backslash
scenarios.when: the rule evaluates the string literal

scenarios.name: should report a regular expression-like string with escape sequences
scenarios.when: the rule evaluates the string literal

scenarios.name: should preserve the runtime value when converting regex source strings
scenarios.given: a string containing doubled backslashes that represent regex source text
scenarios.when: the autofix converts the literal to a String.raw tagged template
scenarios.then: the template raw contents evaluate to the same string value as the original literal

scenarios.name: should avoid unsafe or grammar-sensitive string conversions
scenarios.given: a literal used as a directive, module source, non-computed key, JSX attribute, inline snapshot, TypeScript literal, or containing mixed runtime escapes, a trailing backslash, a backtick, interpolation syntax, or multiple lines
scenarios.when: the rule evaluates the string literal
scenarios.then: no violation or autofix is produced because String.raw could change behavior or create invalid syntax

scenarios.name: should preserve keyword separation and permit computed expression keys
scenarios.given: a safely convertible string immediately follows a return-like keyword or appears in a computed property key
scenarios.when: the autofix creates the String.raw expression
scenarios.then: required whitespace and surrounding expression grammar remain valid
